data.one_liner: Official Dart team lint rules for core and recommended static analysis settings.
data.what_it_does: Defines static analyzer rules for identifying potential bugs, typing issues, and formatting problems in Dart source code. It includes two distinct lint sets: core lints and recommended lints.
use_when: You are starting a new Dart project and want standard team-recommended lints enabled.
You want to ensure your package meets community standards for pub.dev points.
You want to enforce consistent coding style and catch code issues early via static analysis.
avoid_when: You require custom or strict rule sets beyond the standard core and recommended options.
You are using Flutter-specific rule sets where package:flutter_lints might be preferred.
strengths: Official rules maintained directly by the Dart team.
Enabled by default in new projects created via 'dart create'.
Helps improve pub.dev scoring based on passing core lints.
weaknesses: Limited to core and recommended sets without a strict rule set option from the authors.
Requires manual configuration in an analysis_options.yaml file for existing projects.
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies and include the lint set in an analysis_options.yaml file.

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Extends the recommended set with additional recommended Flutter-specific lints for Flutter applications.
